```{r setup}
# boilerplate for multithreading, chunk timing and other operations
# chunk timing code from https://bookdown.org/yihui/rmarkdown-cookbook/time-chunk.html

knitr::knit_hooks$set(time_it = local({
  now <- NULL
  function(before, options) {
    if (before) {
      # record the current time before each chunk
      now <<- Sys.time()
    } else {
      # calculate the time difference after a chunk
      res <- difftime(Sys.time(), now, units = "secs")
      # return a character string to show the time
      paste("Chunk runtime:", round(res,
        2), "seconds")
    }
  }
}))

knitr::opts_chunk$set(time_it = TRUE, echo=TRUE)

library(doParallel) #multi-threading
cl <- makePSOCKcluster((detectCores()-2)) # keep 2 cores free
registerDoParallel(cl)
```
